To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
consumer value co creation is a complex process that requires an iterative and participatory approach to information systems design.

consumer information systems development should be guided by the following six elements: (1) understanding the consumer's experience, (2) understanding consumer's needs, (3) designing for the consumer, (4) understanding consumer's information processing, (5) creating consumer value, (6) understanding the consumer context and environment.

consumer information systems development requires a focus on the co creation of consumer experience, consumer information systems are co produced by consumers and firms, and the co production process involves the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) and is influenced by the context in which the co production occurs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how consumer value is co created in the interaction between consumers, organizations and technology.
understanding how to create value for consumers in the context of information systems design.
the development of a conceptual framework for the design of consumer information systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a framework for developing consumer information systems.
the proposed framework is a useful tool to guide consumer information systems development.
consumer information systems are a unique type of information system that require unique approaches to their design.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the consumer is the key to value creation.
consumer information systems development is a process in which value is co created by the consumers and the organization through the use of the system.
the framework is useful in understanding the development of consumer information systems, but the framework also has limitations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
information systems researchers should consider consumer information system development as a value co creation process that involves both consumers and organizations.
consumer information systems development should be approached as an interactive and iterative process that involves the consumer in co creating value.
the design of a CIS is not just about the technical design of information and communication technologies.
